name: The Devil’s Gun Market
detailed_description:
🔫 The Devil’s Gun Market

A Gun Market Simulator with RPG Storytelling Where Every Deal Could Be Your Last

Welcome to The Devil’s Gun Market, where war, greed, and absolute chaos fuel the economy. You're not some genius strategist or crime lord—you’re just a weapons dealer trying to survive in a world of shifting laws, unpredictable alliances, and morally questionable customers.

Maybe you’ll become a war profiteer, a faction's puppet, or accidentally sell doomsday weapons to the wrong people. Who knows? This world thrives on bad decisions—including yours.

💰 Run Your Own Shady Gun Market

Sell weapons legally or under the table, depending on who’s asking.

Check permits, ID cards, and government restrictions—or forge them for extra cash.

Smuggle weapons, manipulate prices, and dodge unexpected inspections.

Keep up with ever-changing gun laws—one day, your best-seller is legal, the next day, it’s contraband.

🎭 Choose Your Allies… Or Watch Them Ruin You

The Government 🏛️ – Strict laws, endless bureaucracy, and a high price for loyalty.

The Rebels 🔥 – A cause worth fighting for—or just a well-armed mob.

The Devil 😈 – Power, profit, and… unfortunate long-term consequences.

Pick a side, play them against each other, or watch everything collapse while you count your cash.

⚖️ Every Choice Has Consequences (And Usually a Price)

Shape the world through your deals, betrayals, and occasional moral crises.

Multiple endings—ranging from ultimate power to working in a fast-food joint after losing everything.

Stay neutral? Nobody trusts you. Play too aggressively? They’ll make sure you regret it.

And if you think you can outsmart the Devil… well, good luck.

🛠️ Features:

✅ Gun Market Simulator – Buy, sell, smuggle, and hope you don’t get raided.

✅ Papers, Please-Style Checks – Verify IDs, permits, and gun licenses—or ignore them if the price is right.

✅ Faction Power Struggles – Make alliances, betray them, and pray it doesn’t backfire.

✅ Dark Humor & Absurdity – Why does the Devil accept payment in machine guns? Don’t ask.

✅ Dynamic Economy – Laws shift, people hold grudges, and your decisions have weight.

✅ Multiple Endings – Become a kingpin, a government lapdog, or just another unlucky fool.

💀 You don’t have to be a genius to survive in this business—but making dumb mistakes will cost you everything. 🔫

short_description: A darkly humorous gun market simulator with RPG elements. Manage your shady arms business, verify or forge gun permits, navigate shifting laws, and make deals with rebels, the government, or even the Devil. Every choice shapes your fate in this chaotic world of war, profit, and deception.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish

content_descriptors.notes: The Devil’s Gun Market includes themes of crime, war, and moral ambiguity. Players engage in illegal arms dealing, government corruption, and supernatural bargains. The game features realistic violence, mild profanity, psychological horror elements, and moral dilemmas but does not contain extreme gore, sexual content depictions.
